newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania's BRM calls crude oil processing tender.
newsitem.headline: Romania's BRM calls crude oil processing tender.

text.p: Romania's Bucharest-based commodities exchange will call a tender this month for the processing of 1.2 million tonnes of crude over a one-year period, the exchange said on Tuesday.

The crude would be processed at the RAFO SA refinery in Onesti at a rate of 100,000 tonnes a month starting April, under a contract concluded between the exchange and the refinery, Bursa Romana de Marfuri (BRM) said in a statement.
The tender, opened to Romanian and foreign companies, is scheduled for March 19, the statement said, adding that bidders have until March 18 to submit offers.
The statement gave no details related to a minimum starting price to be offered in the tender.

Romania has a large crude oil processing capacity of around 34 million tonnes a year, which it inherited from the former communist regime. It currently operates only half of that, following an acute shortgae of funds to import crude.
